met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over South Chhattisgarh & neighbourhood lies over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining Vidarbha at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 12th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across Vidarbha and south Madhya Pradesh during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, Kota, Betul, centre of Low Pressure Area over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining Vidarbha, Kalingapattanam and thence east southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from South Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Konkan adjoining Eastcentral Arabian sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level titling southwestwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining Jammu now lies over Jammu division & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
